abi: event CampaignCreated(uint256 indexed campaignId, address indexed ngo, uint256 totalFunds)
event DonationReceived(uint256 indexed campaignId, address indexed donor, uint256 amount)
event ProofSubmitted(uint256 indexed campaignId, uint256 milestoneIndex, string invoiceHash, string photoHash, string beneficiaryHash)
event MilestoneApproved(uint256 indexed campaignId, uint256 milestoneIndex)
event FundsScheduled(uint256 indexed campaignId, uint256 milestoneIndex, uint256 amount, uint256 releaseAfter)
event FundsClaimed(uint256 indexed campaignId, uint256 milestoneIndex, uint256 amount)
event DonorsRefunded(uint256 indexed campaignId, uint256 totalRefunded)
event BadgeEarned(address indexed donor, uint256 campaignId)
event RefundTriggered(uint256 indexed campaignId, address triggeredBy)
event SeedReleased(uint256 indexed campaignId, uint256 amount)
event BeneficiaryConfirmed(bytes32 indexed beneficiaryHash, address indexed confirmedBy)
event MilestoneChallenged(uint256 indexed campaignId, uint256 milestoneIndex, address challenger)
event FraudReported(uint256 indexed campaignId, uint256 milestoneIndex, address reporter, uint256 reportId)
event FraudReportResolved(uint256 indexed reportId, bool upheld)
function hasVoted(uint256, uint256, address) view returns (bool)
function submitMilestoneProof(uint256 _campaignId, uint256 _milestoneIndex, string _invoiceHash, string _photoHash, string _beneficiaryHash)
function reportFraud(uint256 _campaignId, uint256 _milestoneIndex, string _evidenceIPFS, string _reason) payable
function generateBeneficiaryHash(uint256 _campaignId, uint256 _milestoneIndex, uint256 _slot) pure returns (bytes32)
function getCampaignBasic(uint256 _campaignId) view returns (uint256 campaignId, address ngoAddress, string title, string description)
function getCampaignFunds(uint256 _campaignId) view returns (uint256 totalFunds, uint256 raisedFunds, uint256 milestoneCount, bool isActive, bool isFrozen, bool seedReleased)
function getCampaignEmergency(uint256 _campaignId) view returns (bool isEmergency, uint256 emergencyVotes)

function getMilestoneBasic(uint256 _campaignId, uint256 _milestoneIndex) view returns (string description, uint256 fundAmount, string invoiceIPFS, string photoIPFS, string beneficiaryIPFS, uint256 deadline)

function getMilestoneStatus(uint256 _campaignId, uint256 _milestoneIndex) view returns (uint256 beneficiaryCount, uint256 confirmedCount, uint8 approvalCount, bool isApproved, bool isRejected, bool fundsReleased)
function getMilestoneChallenge(uint256 _campaignId, uint256 _milestoneIndex) view returns (uint256 approvedAt, bool challenged, uint256 releaseAfter, bool fundsClaimed)
function getFraudReportBasic(uint256 _reportId) view returns (address reporter, uint256 campaignId, uint256 milestoneIndex, string evidenceIPFS, string reason)
function getFraudReportResult(uint256 _reportId) view returns (bool resolved, bool upheld, uint256 stakedAmount)
event NGORegistered(address indexed ngo, string ipfsHash)
function getNGOProfile(address ngo) view returns (string ipfsMetadataHash, bool isVerified, uint256 registeredAt)
function ngoProfiles(address) view returns (string ipfsMetadataHash, bool isVerified, uint256 registeredAt)
